title: Cohomological Aspects of Entanglement Entropy: From Information Theory to Noncommutative Geometry
summary: We develop a cohomological framework for entanglement entropy that unifies information theory, operator algebras, and noncommutative geometry. Entropy is a 1-cocycle in information cohomology; we generalize this to the quantum setting via Hochschild and cyclic cohomology.
